public_rationale: The readable reports document AI-related debt concerns and subsequent positive trading. They do not establish the broad sentiment transition described in the forecast. Nor can continued optimism disprove an eventual reversal with no deadline. Treating ordinary anxiety as 'existential fear' would make the result depend on an evaluator-supplied threshold.
limitations: Several relevant market reports could not be read and were excluded.
News reports describe investor motives but do not provide a representative sentiment measurement.
The forecast's intensity and duration remain ambiguous.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The S&P 500 and NASDAQ are held up by childish excitement about AI growth that will eventually turn to existential fear.

statement.excerpt: The fundamental disconnection between the perception of AI growth inflating the value of hyperscaler stocks and the worrying fact that we don’t really know exactly how much AI revenue they make means that the S&P 500 and NASDAQ are held up by a kind of childish excitement that will, at some point, turn to existential fear.

from_speaker: perception of AI growth inflating the value of hyperscaler stocks
held up by a kind of childish excitement
will, at some point, turn to existential fear
our_interpretation: I treat 'childish' as rhetoric and assess the underlying forecast of a broad shift from AI optimism to fear about the AI boom's viability.
NASDAQ means the Nasdaq Composite in this broad-market context.
The plain reading requires evidence affecting both named indices and linking the sentiment shift specifically to AI economics.
A routine selloff, general risk aversion, or one worried investor does not by itself establish this broad shift.
No numerical drawdown, sentiment threshold, or duration is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Convergent market and investor evidence shows that AI optimism supporting both indices has given way to broad fear about the economic viability of the AI boom.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence decisively disproves the asserted AI-based support mechanism. A rally or continued optimism at a particular date cannot disprove an undated eventual reversal.
